This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 8-3. TYPICAL TOW-HITCH RELEASE HANDLE".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a side view of a typical tow-hitch release handle assembly mounted on a triangular bracket, with a vertical handle lever pivoted at the bracket and a release cable attached at the bottom of the lever.
